summary: Wire the canonical classify_node discriminator into the PRODUCTION extract + interface PHP paths so ClassInfo.kind is populated (additive) for class/interface/trait, matching what structure already emits via the Stage-2 family-1 switch. Single source of truth: crate::ast::entity::classify_node / classify_node_kind. No new per-language kind table.

json_delta.command_extract: extract.classes[] for PHP now emits additive field "kind": class_declaration -> "class", interface_declaration -> "interface", trait_declaration -> "trait". Previously the field was omitted (serde skip_serializing_if Option::is_none). No name/line/bases/methods/docstring/decorators change.

(class_node_kinds(Php) = {class_declaration, interface_declaration}; traits are not in that set, so interface emits no trait carrier.) Previously omitted.
json_delta.axis: All new kind strings are class-axis; the Stage-2 string-keyed consumers (function_finder, agreement test) remain byte-identical. Purely additive — no field removed, no value changed.

scope_notes: FunctionInfo has no kind field (as in all 13 prior Stage-3 commits); function->function / method->method kind is already emitted by structure.definitions via the Stage-2 family-1 entry-kind switch. No FunctionInfo change.

PHP enum_declaration is NOT currently extracted as a class by extract_php_classes_detailed, and structure's family-1 membership drops trait_declaration/enum_declaration. Widening those membership tables would change emitted entity COUNTS (beyond additive-kind) and risk floor goldens, so it is intentionally OUT OF SCOPE for this additive-kind commit. classify_node already returns Enum/Trait for those node kinds, so a future membership-widening commit needs no classifier change.
